welcome.guest_text: One workspace for voyages, land transit, companies, and accounting — built for daily shipping work.
welcome.logged_in_text: Your session is ready. Open the dashboard to continue where you left off.

auth.sign_in_subtitle: Enter your credentials to access the Shipping ERP dashboard.
auth.create_account_subtitle: Set up your workspace access in a few seconds.
auth.reset_subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a secure reset link.
auth.choose_password_subtitle: Create a strong password to secure your account.
auth.verify_email_text: Thanks for signing up! Before getting started, verify your email by clicking the link we just emailed you. If you didn't receive it, we will gladly send another.
auth.verify_link_sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.
auth.confirm_password_text: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.
auth.visual_text: Track ships, cargos, companies, and accounting in one clear workspace built for daily shipping operations.
auth.visual_footer: Designed for clarity • Built for scale

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your shipping workspace is ready. Next modules build on permissions, settings, ships, and voyages — without clutter.
dashboard.focus_text: Clean tables, strong filters, and calm surfaces for long workdays.
dashboard.accounting_text: Balances are calculated from journal entries — never edited directly.
dashboard.import_text: Voyage car imports will reuse proven parsing, rebuilt as clean services.
dashboard.voyages_text: Open a voyage and run the workflow.
dashboard.company_debts_help: Click a card to open the company ledger. Color scales with debt vs the largest balance.
dashboard.pinned_accounts_help: Accounts you flagged for fast access to the ledger from the home page.

common.name: Name
common.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this item?

action_pin.title: PIN confirmation
action_pin.label: PIN code
action_pin.hint: Checked automatically when all digits are entered.
action_pin.message_void: Enter the PIN to void voucher {voucher}.
action_pin.message_reverse: Enter the PIN to reverse voucher {voucher}.
action_pin.message_payment: Enter the PIN to post this receipt or payment.
action_pin.message_delete_account: Enter the PIN to delete account {code}.
action_pin.message_wallet: Enter the PIN to post this wallet movement.
action_pin.message_driver_payment: Enter the PIN to post this driver payment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.company_help: Basic identity details shown across the ERP workspace.
settings.logo_help: Shown on cash receipt and payment voucher prints.
settings.localization_help: Company defaults for time, language, and currency. Each user can also change language from the top bar.
settings.whatsapp_help: Tenant ID and on/off switch for the external WhatsApp queue API.
settings.land_trips_cash_account_help: Cash box used for company wallet deposits/withdrawals and driver payments (قاسة). Must be an active USD cash or asset account.
settings.match_aliases_help: One alias per line (matched from Excel status column)
settings.migrations_help: Runs pending migrations only (migrate --force). Fresh and rollback are not available here.
settings.clear_log_confirm: Clear application log files now? This cannot be undone.

users.title: Users
users.help: Create users and assign roles for secure ERP access.
users.create_help: New users are verified automatically and can sign in immediately.
users.password_optional: Leave password empty to keep the current password.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Update your name, email, and password for this workspace.
profile.info_help: This name appears in logs, receipts, and the header.
profile.password_help: Use a strong password you do not reuse elsewhere.
profile.verify_sent: A new verification link was sent to your email.
profile.danger_help: This permanently deletes your login. Operational and accounting records stay in the system.
profile.delete_confirm_text: Enter your password to permanently delete your account. This cannot be undone.

roles.title: Roles & Permissions
roles.help: Control what each role can access across the ERP modules.
roles.select_permissions: Select the permissions this role should have.

accounts.title: Chart of Accounts
accounts.aed_hint: Use AED for Dubai / Ship related accounts.
accounts.system_edit_hint: System account used by automated postings. You can edit it; change the code carefully.
accounts.posted_structure_locked: Type and currency cannot be changed after this account has posted journal movements.
accounts.company_ar_locked: Company receivable accounts keep fixed code, type, currency, and parent.
accounts.ledger_help: Posted vouchers only. Balances are calculated from journal lines and never stored.
accounts.ledger_none: No posted activity in this period.
accounts.movement_help: Receipt = debit this account (it received the value). Payment = credit this account (the value left it).
accounts.receipt_help: Receipt: this account is debit because it received the value.
accounts.payment_help: Payment: this account is credit because the value left it.
accounts.edit_movement_help: Amount and accounts stay locked after posting. You can edit the description and attach an image. Delete voids the voucher without erasing history.
accounts.void_confirm: Void voucher {voucher}? It stays in the accounting history and leaves this ledger.
accounts.reverse_confirm: Reverse voucher {voucher}? An opposite entry (debit↔credit) will be posted and the original will be voided so the balance stays correct.
accounts.show_on_dashboard_help: Pin this account on the home page for quick ledger access.

journals.title: Journal Entries
journals.help: Double-entry vouchers. Balances are calculated from posted lines only.
journals.reverse_confirm: Reverse voucher {voucher}? An opposite entry (debit↔credit) will be posted and the original will be voided so the balance stays correct.
journals.aed_hint: Choose AED for Dubai / Ship vouchers.
journals.post_confirm: Post this journal entry? Posted vouchers cannot be edited.

ships.title: Ships
ships.help: Vessel master records before creating voyages.
ships.name: Ship name
ships.form_help: Register vessel identity once and reuse it on every voyage.
ships.show_help: Multi-owner shares, ship-level expenses, and linked voyages — each layer stays separate.
ships.cost_model_help: 1) One or more owners with ownership %. 2) General ship expenses (maintenance/insurance…). 3) Voyage expenses stay on the voyage page. Profit split by share comes later.

ship_owners.title: Ship owners
ship_owners.help: Two or more owners can share the vessel. Total shares cannot exceed 100%.
ship_owners.none_help: Add two or more people and set each share.
ship_owners.where: Add/edit owners from this tab on the ship page.

ship_expenses.title: Ship expenses
ship_expenses.help: Like the partner sheet: one owner spends, the other pays installments. Totals and difference first; journal posting is optional.
ship_expenses.none_help: Record fleet costs here. Voyage expenses are added on the voyage page.
ship_expenses.accounting_note: Default post: Dr ship expense (5110/5200) / Cr partner clearing (2210/2215) tagged to the spending owner. Cash post remains available.
ship_expenses.post_confirm: Post this ship expense as a journal entry?
ship_expenses.import_help: Fills the row list above. Review, then save the list. Columns: Date, Reason, Amount, optional Paid by.
ship_expenses.import_filled: Filled {count} rows. Skipped: {skipped}. Save the list to store them.
ship_expenses.import_failed: Could not read the Excel file.
ship_expenses.paid_by_help: If an owner paid the expense, it counts in that partner's payments and journal clearing.
ship_expenses.print_footer: Operational partner ledger. Journal posting is optional and not required for this report.

ship_partners.title: Partner payments
ship_partners.help: Installments paid by the non-spending partner toward ship costs.
ship_partners.none_help: Record what the other owner transferred for ship expenses.
ship_partners.post_confirm: Post this payment as Dr cash / Cr partner clearing (2210)?
ship_partners.import_help: Fills the payment list above. Review, then save. Columns: Date, Reason, Amount.
ship_partners.import_filled: Filled {count} payments. Skipped: {skipped}. Save the list to store them.
ship_partners.accounting_note: Posting: Dr cash/bank / Cr 2210 Ship Partner Clearing with that owner.

voyages.title: Voyages
voyages.help: Each voyage is linked to a ship and follows a clear status cycle.
voyages.form_help: Voyages start as draft. Activate when operations begin.
voyages.show_help: Voyage details, status transitions, and AED cost fields.
voyages.next_step: Next: attach shipping companies and car manifest to this voyage.
voyages.next_step_cars: Next: add the car manifest (Excel) for each company.
voyages.no_waypoints: No waypoints yet. Default approximate route is shown.
voyages.route_info_help: Tracking is approximate based on port dates and user-added waypoints. No GPS device required.

voyage_companies.title: Shipping companies
voyage_companies.help: Link a master company and set voyage rates. Name and contacts live once in Companies.
voyage_companies.none: No companies on this voyage yet.
voyage_companies.none_help: Select an existing company or create one — identity is saved once for reuse.
voyage_companies.create_new: Create new company (saved to master list)
voyage_companies.master_hint: Company name and contacts come from the master record.
voyage_companies.edit_identity_hint: To change name or contacts, edit the master company:

companies.title: Shipping companies
companies.help: Master list of shipping companies — saved once, linked to many voyages. Rates stay per voyage.
companies.form_help: Name and contact details. The company running account posts at voyage settlement / collection.
companies.name: Company name
companies.ledger_help: Running AR under 1600 — each company has a child account. Balance is derived from posted journals only.
companies.statement_help: Charges (debit) from voyage revenue or a direct receivable; receipts (credit) from money vouchers. One payment may cover several voyages.
companies.direct_charge_help: Company owes us without a voyage invoice. Posts Dr company AR / Cr revenue (default 4100) — balanced double-entry.
companies.credit_account_help: Default is shipping revenue 4100. You may pick another income, liability, or equity account in USD.
companies.whatsapp_phone_help: If empty, contact phone is used
companies.payments_help: Receipt vouchers for this company, including voyage allocations.
companies.cars_help: This company's cars across all voyages. Search by chassis number or car name/description.
companies.no_cars: No cars linked to this company.

dubai_accounts.title: Dubai accounts
dubai_accounts.help: Operational AED statement with Dubai loading/receiving partners — no journal posting in this phase.
dubai_accounts.form_help: Partner name and contact. Manage the statement from the partner page.
dubai_accounts.ledger_help: Operational AED running account — balance is derived from debit and credit.
dubai_accounts.statement_help: Car transport / forklift = debit; transfers = credit. Import an SOA Excel file.
dubai_accounts.import_soa_help: File like SOA Salam Jalal: DATE / NO_DOC / Car transport / Forklift / CREDIT.
dubai_accounts.cars_help: Upload a car manifest Excel for this shipment (voyage link comes later).
dubai_accounts.no_cars: No cars imported for this line.

voyage_cars.title: Car manifest
voyage_cars.help: Add cars manually or import Excel per shipping company. Chassis is unique per voyage.
voyage_cars.import_help: Columns: S.NO | WEIGHT | SHIPPER | DESCRIPTION | CHASSIS NO | CONSIGNEE | COMPANY | CODE
voyage_cars.need_company: Add a shipping company before adding cars.
voyage_cars.none: No cars on this manifest yet.
voyage_cars.none_help: Add manually or import an Excel file for a shipping company.

voyage_expenses.title: Voyage expenses
voyage_expenses.help: Operational expense log with optional double-entry posting — balances come from journals only.
voyage_expenses.none_help: Add fuel, port, customs, or other expenses for this voyage.
voyage_expenses.accounting_note: Voyage operational list. General ship costs live on the ship page. Posting is Dr/Cr only — never edit balances directly.
voyage_expenses.post_confirm: Post this expense as a journal entry? It cannot be edited after posting.

voyage_settlements.title: Settlements
voyage_settlements.help: Dues calculated from rates × car count. No stored balances — every figure is derived.
voyage_settlements.commission_hint: Calculated automatically: commission per car × cars count.
voyage_settlements.note: Operational figures only. Post revenue and collect receipts after settlement — company dues are derived here; cash clearing is via money vouchers.
voyage_settlements.owners_help: Voyage profit (USD) split by ship ownership % — derived, never a stored balance.
voyage_settlements.no_owners_help: Add owners on the ship page to see profit allocation here.
voyage_settlements.posting_help: Double-entry journals only — balances are derived and never edited directly.
voyage_settlements.post_revenue_hint: Dr each company’s AR (under 1600) / Cr Shipping Revenue 4100 (USD).
voyage_settlements.post_revenue_confirm: Post shipping revenue as a journal entry?
voyage_settlements.post_commission_confirm: Post captain commission as a journal entry?
voyage_settlements.collect_hint: Create a receipt voucher (Dr cash/bank / Cr AR 1600) for this voyage.
voyage_settlements.company_movements_help: Charges and receipts tagged to this voyage on each company’s running AR account.
voyage_settlements.no_company_movements: No posted company movements on this voyage yet. Post revenue or collect a receipt.

money_vouchers.title: Receipts & payments
money_vouchers.help: Cash and bank vouchers that clear AR/AP via double-entry journals. Balances are never edited directly.
money_vouchers.form_help: Receipts require a shipping company. Allocate to one or more voyages, or leave remainder on the company account.
money_vouchers.show_help: Receipt: Dr cash/bank / Cr the company’s AR child under 1600 (optionally split by voyage). Payment: Dr AP / Cr cash/bank.
money_vouchers.company_hint: Receipt reduces this company’s running AR balance.
money_vouchers.allocations_help: Optional. Split this payment across voyages; any remainder stays on the company account.
money_vouchers.no_allocations: No voyage splits — full amount ({amount}) credits the company account.
money_vouchers.post_confirm: Post this voucher? A journal entry will be created and the voucher locked.
money_vouchers.posting_hint: Receipt clears the company’s AR account under 1600. Payment clears AP 2100. USD only.
money_vouchers.not_posted: Not posted yet — still a draft.

reports.title: Reports
reports.help: Operational voyage overview for revenue, costs, and profit. Figures are derived — never stored balances.
reports.voyages_help: Estimated revenue, cost, and profit per voyage.
reports.note: Operational derived figures. Export Excel or PDF using the same filters.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp notifications
whatsapp.subtitle: Queued messages sent to companies via the external WhatsApp API.

land_trips.title: Land transit
land_trips.help: CMR land trips with driver, origin/destination country, and a car manifest.
land_trips.companies_help: Open a shipping company to see its cars by location, or import Excel.
land_trips.company_trips_help: Trips and routes for this company. Open a trip to manage cars or import Excel.
land_trips.cars_by_country_help: Counts follow the location assigned to each car, after linking that location to a country.
land_trips.no_country_cars: No cars with a country-linked location yet.
land_trips.select_all_cars: Select all cars on this page
land_trips.bulk_move_hint: Choose a location, then apply it to the selected cars.
land_trips.no_cars_action: Import Excel or add cars manually to get started.
land_trips.empty_cars: No cars for this company yet.
land_trips.empty_archive_help: Move arrived cars to Archive to hide them from the main list.
land_trips.none_for_company: No trips for this company yet.
land_trips.cars_after_save_hint: You can also import Excel after saving the trip.
land_trips.form_help: Choose the company and route (from/to), then add cars manually or import Excel after save.
land_trips.check_help: Paste chassis numbers, one per line, then run search against this company’s cars.
land_trips.check_placeholder: Paste chassis numbers here, one per line
land_trips.check_load_fail: Could not load the car index.
land_trips.check_empty_help: Paste chassis numbers then run search.
land_trips.wallet_help: Company wallet posts to accounting: deposit Dr cash / Cr company receivable; withdraw Dr receivable / Cr cash.
land_trips.wallet_freight_help: Car prices are summed every time you open the wallet, including archived cars. Deposits are subtracted from that total.
land_trips.wallet_delete_confirm: Delete wallet voucher {voucher}? The journal will be voided.
land_trips.wallet_print_footer: Posted to the company cash account and accounts receivable.
land_trips.wallet_cash_missing: Set the land-trips cash account (قاسة) in Settings before posting wallet or driver payments.
land_trips.driver_account_help: Pay a driver from the company cash box. This is a company debt: Dr receivable / Cr cash.
land_trips.driver_delete_confirm: Delete driver payment for {name}? The journal will be voided.
land_trips.attach_file_help: Image or PDF, up to 10 MB.
land_trips.chassis_letter_o_hint: A chassis number cannot contain the letter O. This car was entered before the check. O should be 0.
land_trips.chassis_letter_o_banner: {count} cars still have the letter O in the chassis. They were entered before this check.
land_trips.cars_help: Manifest for this CMR. Add rows in the popup, or pull cars from a linked sea voyage.
land_trips.add_cars_help: Add new cars only. Existing cars stay unchanged.
land_trips.edit_car_help: Update chassis, model, color, year, and other car details.
land_trips.edit_car_error: Fix the highlighted fields and try again.
land_trips.duplicates_none: No duplicate chassis or matching last 6 digits in this company.
land_trips.cars_modal_help: Add dynamic rows. Save writes all cars in one step.
land_trips.no_car_rows: No rows yet. Add a row or fill from the sea voyage.
land_trips.no_cars: No cars on this trip yet.
land_trips.post_confirm: Post land transit freight as a journal entry (Dr AR 1600 / Cr 4200)?
land_trips.location_log_help: Each location change is stored in order. Undo reverses the latest applied change, then the one before it.
land_trips.import_log_help: Each Excel import is stored with the file name and car counts. Undo soft-deletes cars created by the latest import only; cars that already existed and were updated are left unchanged.
land_trips.cmr_groups_empty: No CMR groups match the current filters.
land_trips.cmr_groups_load_error: Could not load CMR groups. Please try again.
land_trips.model_groups_empty: No model groups match the current filters.
land_trips.model_groups_load_error: Could not load model groups. Please try again.
land_trips.cmr_file_upload_error: Could not upload the file. Check type and size, then try again.
land_trips.cmr_file_remove_error: Could not remove the file. Please try again.
land_trips.cmr_file_remove_confirm: Remove the attachment for this CMR group?
land_trips.cmr_rename_error: Could not rename CMR. Please try again.
land_trips.import_help: Upload Sorted Inventory. Columns Vehicle Model and Color are read from the header. The preview table is the source of import: edit, delete, or add rows, then confirm.
land_trips.preview_stats: {ready} ready · {invalid} invalid chassis · {skipped} will not import

import_reason.description_too_long: Car name is longer than 255 characters

iran_cars.title: Iran Cars
iran_cars.help: Unsold Iran border inventory, then sold cars with sale price and installments. Uses AR 1660 / revenue 4300, not shipping 1600.
iran_cars.form_help: Assign a company and border, then set the car total. Journals post only when total is greater than zero.
iran_cars.form_help_unsold: The car is added to unsold inventory. Revenue posts only after you move it to sold.
iran_cars.import_help: Upload the Sorted Inventory workbook. Border headers are detected automatically. PRICE is optional for unsold stock and becomes sale price when importing as sold.
iran_cars.total_locked: Total and company are locked after the first payment.
iran_cars.sale_price_locked: Sale price and company are locked after the first payment.
iran_cars.reverse_payment_confirm: Reverse payment {voucher}? The journal will be voided.
iran_cars.sell_help: Enter the sale price. Posts Dr 1660 / Cr 4300, then installments reduce the remaining balance.
iran_cars.pool_payment_help: Applies to the sum of all sold Iran cars without allocating to each VIN. Choose the company whose Iran AR (1660) to credit.
